title: The anatomy of a personal health agent
description: A personal health agent coordinates data analysis, health expertise and coaching to improve evaluated conversational support over single-agent and parallel-agent baselines, without establishing long-term health benefits. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Heydari, A. Ali et al., 10.1038/s41586-026-11161-8Version of record, 2026-10-21 — https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11161-8
